author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a closer look at what's coming to Fallout Shelter and Fallout 4 Creations from Verified Creators in this Fallout Day Celebrations 2026 video. Fallout Shelter will receive a new Baby Deathclaw companion and new seasons. Fallout 4 Creations features three new mods coming for Fallout 4, including FEVer Dreams from Kinggath Creations, Command Override from Hobgoblin Studios, and Fathomless from ZoneZeroCreations.

FEVer Dreams is an escape room-style dungeon that "inundates players with hallucinations and flashbacks, including conversations with their spouse.” FEVer Dreams features the returning voices of Courtenay Taylor (who played the female sole Survivor in Fallout 4) and Brian T. Delaney (who played the male Sole Survivor in Fallout 4). FEVer Dreams is available for Fallout 4 today, October 20, 2026.

title: Fallout - Official Fallout Day Celebrations 2026: Fallout Shelter and Fallout 4 Updates Video

description: Check out the trailer for FEVer Dreams, a free escape room-style dungeon mod for Fallout 4 from Kinggath Creations. FEVer Dreams is an escape room-style dungeon that "inundates players with hallucinations and flashbacks, including conversations with their spouse.” FEVer Dreams features the returning voices of Courtenay Taylor (who played the female sole Survivor in Fallout 4) and Brian T. Delaney (who played the male Sole Survivor in Fallout 4). FEVer Dreams is available today, October 20, for Fallout 4.
title: FEVer Dreams (Fallout 4 Creation) - Official Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Learn about the story and get a peek at gameplay from Trailblazers: Into the March in this new trailer for the upcoming roguelite colony-sim strategy game. In Trailblazers: Into the March, command your Landship in tactical battles, care for a crew composed of all sorts of characters, shape your home, manage resources, and lead expeditions into the March. Discover what lies at its heart... and in yours. Trailblazers: Into the March will be available on PC and Mac. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Trailblazers: Into the March - Official Demo Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the ‘Halloween 5: The Revenge of Michael Myers’ Scythe Reveal Trailer for Halloween: The Game, an asymmetrical horror action game developed by Illfonic. Players can soon rock Michael Myers' iconic skin from Halloween 5: The Revenge of Michael Myers, with his signature scythe from the film. Rock the ‘Halloween 5: The Revenge of Michael Myers’ Scythe skin in Halloween: The Game, launching on October 27 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Halloween: The Game - Official ‘Halloween 5: The Revenge of Michael Myers’ Scythe Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Melon Sandbox x Poppy Playtime trailer as the ragdoll physics game Melon Sandbox gets a collaboration with the mascot horror game Poppy Playtime, which brings some of Poppy Playtime's terrifying toys to life in a limited-time Halloween event. Poppy Playtime mascots (Huggy Wuggy, Mommy Long Legs, The Prototype, Boxy Boo, and more) are coming to Melon Sandbox in a spine-tingling themed board game event, available from October 23 to November 2, 2026. Melon Sandbox is free to play on iOS, Android, and browser.
title: Melon Sandbox x Poppy Playtime - Official Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: You're an Inquisitor following a trail of death. A cult is at work, your predecessor has vanished, and the region teeters on the edge of chaos. Find the truth. Uphold the Inquisition. Do not fail. Get another look Inkblood in this trailer for the upcoming 2D mystery adventure game. Inkblood will be available on Steam, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, Xbox on PC, and Xbox Game Pass in 2027.
title: Inkblood - Official Demo Trailer | Critical Reflex Time Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Revenant Survivors is a horde survival action roguelite set in a Diablo-inspired dark fantasy world. Tear through endless hordes with hard-hitting combat, absorb souls, steal bosses’ skills, and even take their bodies to become evil incarnate. Check out the Revenant Survivors trailer to see gameplay and more. Revenant Survivors will be available in Early Access on November 9, 2026.
title: Revenant Survivors - Official Early Access Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: You’re sick. So is the city. Explore a crumbling Terminal that loops when you die. Solve cursed investigations. Weaponize your symptoms. Find the truth, or spiral with it. Check out the trailer for Heavy As Stone, an upcoming exploration horror investigation game. Heavy As Stone will be available on Steam and Xbox Series X/S.
title: Heavy as Stone - Official Trailer | Critical Reflex Time Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Gameplay Trailer for No, I'm Not Human, a decision-based psychological horror game developed by Trioskaz. Players will investigate visitors at the door to ensure they're a true biological human during the trying times of Earth's end. No, I'm Not Human is available now on PC (Steam), with the game coming soon t0 PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, and Nintendo Switch.
title: No, I'm Not Human - Official Gameplay Trailer | Critical Reflex Time Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Console Release Date Trailer for Mouthwashing, an atmospheric psychological horror game developed by Wrong Organ. Players will witness the five crew members of the Tulpar that are stranded in the empty reaches of space, shrouded in perpetual sunset. God is not watching. Mouthwashing is launching on October 29 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, Xbox on PC, and Nintendo Switch, with the game available now on PC (Steam).
title: Mouthwashing - Official Console Release Date Trailer | Critical Reflex Time Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Gameplay Trailer for Pipes.exe, a first-person co-op horror game developed by Moving Pieces Interactive. Players will climb through testing environments as a low-level QA employee for a Perfectly Legitimate Tech Company™. Survive a series of simulated assignments and brutal corporate life. Pipes.exe is coming soon to Xbox Series X|S and PC (Steam and Xbox on PC), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Pipes.exe - Official Gameplay Trailer | Critical Reflex Time Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Gameplay Trailer for SATED, an action roguelike simulation game developed by Forest Reges. Players will engage with a cursed fridge that beckons those who dare. Spin the wheel and choose revolting ingredients in this rogue-like-inspired cooking course from the very depths of hell. Leave your customers satisfied or become the meal yourself. SATED is coming soon to Xbox Series X|S and PC (Steam and Xbox on PC).
title: SATED - Official Gameplay Trailer | Critical Reflex Time Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Demo Launch Trailer for Tanuki: Pon's Summer, an open-world life simulation game developed by Denkiworks. Players will traverse the town as a part-time worker in a Post Office to deliver packages, meet the locals, and ensure positive vibes persist as Summer ends. Tanuki: Pon's Summer is coming soon to Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam and Xbox on PC), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Tanuki: Pon's Summer - Official Demo Launch Trailer | Critical Reflex Time Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Gameplay Trailer for Keykruncher, a retro typing incremental gambling game developed by Sunscorched Studios. Players will look down, follow the monitor, KLICK the correct KEY, and KRUNCH. Earn enough Compliance Points before IT eats you. Keykruncher is coming soon to Xbox Series X|S and PC (Steam and Xbox on PC).
title: Keykruncher - Official Gameplay Trailer | Critical Reflex Time Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Demo Launch Trailer for Militsioner, a first-person stealth action game developed by Tallboys. Players will sneak through the city under the watchful eye of the Colossal Policeman. Anger, please, or deceive him to escape in Militsioner, coming soon to Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, and PC (Steam and Xbox on PC), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Militsioner - Official Demo Launch Trailer | Critical Reflex Time Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Demo Launch Trailer for Tiny Chills: Not From Ear, a narrative-driven psychological horror game developed by Ducktopus Games. Players will embody an ear cleaner in a quaint town filled with anomalies and horrors below the human skin. Tiny Chills: Not From Ear is coming soon to PC (Steam and Xbox on PC), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Tiny Chills: Not From Ear - Official Demo Launch Trailer | Critical Reflex Time Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Gameplay Trailer for Shrek 2 Remastered, a modern version of the hit co-op adventure game developed by Aspyr. Players will relive iconic moments from iconic locations in the animated film, from the fairytale kingdom of Far Far Away to Shrek’s swamp. Enjoy improved graphics, new features, and more in Shrek 2 Remastered, launching on November 10 for Xbox Series X|S.
title: Shrek 2 Remastered - Official Gameplay Trailer | ID@Xbox Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
The Big Bad Wolf is back. Watch the latest trailer for The Wolf Among Us Remastered, an upcoming narrative-driven adventure game. The new story trailer gives a first look at Bigby's redesigned werewolf form. The definitive edition of Telltale's acclaimed detective thriller remasters Bigby's first investigation with enhanced visuals, upgraded animation and audio, an all-new Noir Mode, behind-the-scenes bonus content, and playable deleted scenes restored from the original 2013 production.

The Wolf Among Us Remastered will be available on Xbox One, playable on Xbox Series X/S through backward compatibility, and Cloud on October 29, 2026. It will also be available on PC, Nintendo Switch, and PlayStation 5 (PS5).
title: The Wolf Among Us Remastered - Official Story Trailer | ID@Xbox Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Xbox Trailer for Zero Parades: Director's Cut, an espionage RPG developed by ZA/UM. Players will endure the trials and tribulations of a single operative on one final mission. The latest update is packed with more material, revisions, improvements, and more. Zero Parades: Director's Cut is launching on November 3 for Xbox Series X|S and PC.
title: Zero Parades: Director's Cut - Official Xbox Release Date Trailer | ID@Xbox Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Arctic Eggs, Mouthwashing, and No, I'm Not Human are coming to Xbox. Check out this trailer for another look at these three unconventional games from publisher Critical Reflex. 

Can you fry eggs on top of Mount Everest? In Arctic Eggs, make an omelette out of beer bottles, bullets and cigarettes in this dystopian, physics-and-patience-driven frying sim set in a surreal Antarctic city. Oh, and there are eggs too. Arctic Eggs, from developer The Water Museum, is available today (October 20, 2026) on Xbox Series X/S.

In Mouthwashing, take responsibility for the dying crew of a shipwrecked space freighter in this psychological horror drama from developer Wrong Organ. Mouthwashing is coming to Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, and Xbox Game Pass on October 29, 2026. 

In No, I'm Not Human, interrogate door-knocking strangers to spot deadly shape-shifting impostors in an apocalyptic anxiety thriller from developer Trioskaz. No, I'm Not Human will be available on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, and Xb
title: Arctic Eggs, Mouthwashing, and No, I'm Not Human - Official Sizzle Reel Trailer | ID@Xbox Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Graytail is a mystery action-adventure in a 2.5D pixel-art world. A famous pilot has vanished somewhere in the Pacific. A detective with a headache that never stops takes the case, with the pilot's daughter at his side. Grab your cane, get on your motorbike, and uncover the island's secrets. The deeper you dig, the less you can trust. Check out the Graytail trailer to see gameplay and more ahead of the mystery action-adventure game's launch on PC and Xbox Series X/S in November 2027.
title: Graytail - Official Trailer | ID@Xbox Fall 2026

description:
an action horror game developed by Red Barrels. author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the latest Mortal Shell 2 trailer to see what to expect from the Rotten Autumn update, which brings a new Photo Mode, new Shell skins, 10 new Tarstones, 15 new dungeons, and a new soundtrack by Sakis Tolis to the action RPG. Mortal Shell 2 is available now on Steam, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox. The free Rotten Autumn update is out now.

Their Flesh Is Your Weapon. Mortal Shell 2 is a standalone sequel action-RPG with adrenaline-charged, high-stakes combat. Possess warrior Shells, dethrone false gods, redeem a ravaged world.
title: Mortal Shell 2: Rotten Autumn - Official Free Seasonal Update Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Nintendo Switch 2 Demo Launch Trailer for Monster Hunter Wilds, the hit monster-hunting action RPG developed by Capcom. Players can get a taste of the adventure with the latest Prologue Demo that takes hunters through the beginning of the game, with save data carrying over to the full game. The Prologue Demo for Monster Hunter Wilds is available now for Nintendo Switch 2, with the full game launching on December 4.
title: Monster Hunter Wilds - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Accolades Trailer for Silent Hill: Townfall, a first-person adventure horror game developed by Konami. Players will explore the island of St. Amelia, which is stranger than it seems. Fight deeper into the town and seek out fragments from the past in Silent Hill: Townfall, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC (Steam, Epic Games Store, and GOG).
title: Silent Hill: Townfall - Official Accolades Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Scam Line is a 4–8 player social deception game where your party will face different challenges. Become a liar, a manipulator, a cheater, or find your own path to victory. Check out the trailer. Scam Line is available now in Early Access, and Version 1.0 launches on PC on November 3, 2026.
title: Scam Line Version 1.0 - Official Cinematic Trailer
